name: Custom Cup
author: Kyouko8
description:
Built into the launcher, from Custom Cup by Kyouko8.
Play a cup of four tracks of your choice ("Copa Personalizada").
- R1 ("Copa Personalizada") on the cup menu opens the track menu to choose the four tracks; on the single race track menu it turns the choosing on, and again ("Cancelar copa") cancels it.
- While choosing, Cross adds the focused track: its label says "Pista n de 4" and the chosen tracks' pictures show in a row at the top left, with a white frame. Circle ("Quitar pista") takes the last one out; with none chosen it goes back as always. Square still moves to a random track, so a random cup is Square + Cross four times. The fourth track opens the cup's race settings (laps, difficulty), then its four races with the cup standings, as an Arcade cup.
- Circle goes back to the menu where you started the cup.
- Offline only: in online games the buttons are not there.
- Works with Ultimate Customizer (its lap counts apply to this cup too) and Customisation Loadouts. Winning it marks no cup's stars.
